subject.title: [Feature]: Support Excel (.xlsx/.xls) and generic binary uploads in gateway / input_file

question: Should Gateway `/v1/responses` add a first-class binary `input_file` workspace receipt contract, and what default allowlist, persistence, redaction, and tool-access policy should it use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but implementing it changes public upload semantics and security boundaries beyond a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Add a scoped binary receipt contract
options.body: Use the existing `files.allowedMimes` and byte limits to stage allowlisted binary payloads into a sanitized workspace attachment directory with metadata, redaction, and explicit unsupported errors.

options.title: Keep input_file text/PDF-only
options.body: Leave `/v1/responses` limited to text/PDF extraction and direct Excel workflows to conversion, skills, or a future plugin surface.

options.title: Defer to provider-native file input
options.body: Track this under the broader provider-native file/document abstraction before adding a local workspace receipt path.

recommendation.title: Add a scoped binary receipt contract
recommendation.body: Use the existing `files.allowedMimes` and byte limits to stage allowlisted binary payloads into a sanitized workspace attachment directory with metadata, redaction, and explicit unsupported errors.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history on the OpenResponses `input_file` implementation and related Gateway input refactors.
